title: Cell offset
statement: Given a list of segments, an index $s$, a cell index $c$, and a Boolean marker $p$, the cell offset is $2c+p$ when the selected segment's flag is true, and is $c$ when that flag is false; here a Boolean is identified with $0$ or $1$.
